question: A button usually has a normal, a hover and a disabled look. Should one component be able to hold all three under one name, with a copy picking which one it shows?
context: Today a component is one drawing. Showing a disabled button beside a normal one means making a second component by hand, and the two drift apart the first time somebody edits one. The app already lets a component hold two shapes and lets a copy pick between them (Make Alternatives), which is the small version of this question.

options.label: Versions under one name
options.summary: A component can hold several complete versions, each with a name like Normal, Hover or Disabled. A copy has a Version menu and you pick which one it shows. Each version is its own drawing, so a version can differ in any way at all.
pros: The way designers already think about a button with states
A version can differ in any way: a different shape, an extra icon, a whole different arrangement
A copy keeps its own wording and colours when it switches version
cons: A change that should reach every version, like a corner radius, has to be made in each one
options.mitigation: Start with a duplicate: a new version is made by copying an existing one, so the versions are the same until you change one on purpose.

options.label: One drawing, versions record only the differences
options.summary: There is still one drawing. A version records only what changes: colours, wording, whether a part shows. A copy picks a version by name and the differences are applied on top.
pros: A change to anything shared reaches every version by itself
Less to keep in your head: one drawing, a short list of differences
cons: A version cannot differ in shape or arrangement, so a disabled button with an extra lock icon is out
Two ways of saying the same thing: the difference list and the knobs a copy already has
options.mitigation: Offer to promote a version to a drawing of its own the first time somebody needs a structural difference.

options.label: Leave it as Make Alternatives
options.summary: Keep what is there: a component can hold two shapes and a copy picks between them. Anything bigger stays a second component made by hand.
pros: The time goes into auto layout, which is mid flight
cons: A button with three states is three components that drift apart
The objective for this epic names variants
options.mitigation: Revisit once auto layout is finished and there is a real screen to build with it.
